name: Premium Reward Bag
displayDescription:
The Premium Reward Bag gamepass allows the player to collect from the Premium Reward Bag, which contains items obtained whenever the player levels up their Account Level. The Premium Reward Bag can be claimed at any time once the pass is purchased, and any rewards from previous levels will automatically become available.

The TOTAL amount of Rewards given at Level 100:
5 EGO Tickets
11 Mega Reflection Tickets
10 Reflection Tickets
4000 Paid Fragments
3 Cosmetic Vouchers

name: 50% Condense
displayDescription:
Add a 1.5x Condense Multiplier to the end of every run!
Stacks Additively

name: Detour Reward Bag
displayDescription:
This package allows you to claim the additional Premium Rewards from completing Detour Quests. Detour Quests are persistent, won't reset, and can be claimed at any time. The price of this gamepass will increase with each released Detour, to a specified amount. The amount of rewards will also further increase. You won't be charged or forced to make another purchase if you've already bought the gamepass before the price increase.

The Premium Rewards are as follows:
350 Paid Fragments
10 Reflection Ticket
1 Mega Reflection Ticket
1 EGO Ticket
1 SR Guaranteed Mega Ticket
Exclusive Title that showcases your Detour High Score

name: +2 Prescripts
displayDescription: Increases your Prescript count from 3 to 5. Does NOT immediately give you +2 Prescripts, but will give you 5 at the beginning of each day instead of 3.

name: Double Fathoms Pity
displayDescription: Gain 2x Fathoms from ALL sources, including Pulls, Clears, and Pity

name: Devyat VIP
displayDescription:
Doubles the quantity of each Delivery task given.
Does not increase the amount of Deliveries

DEVYAT DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY TAKE EFFECT: YOU MUST WAIT UNTIL THE NEXT DAY TO SEE THE DOUBLED QUANTITY

name: Masterful Tinkerer
displayDescription:
When upgrading an 'Equipment' or 'Augment' in the Non-Distinct Workshop, change the first '+0' rolled on upgrades to a maximum of '+1'. 

*This gamepass does not affect the chance to roll a value increase, it will only replace your first failure.

name: Double Deliveries
displayDescription: Doubles the amount of deliveries you can do every day, allowing you to trade in game Condense for other items!

name: 50% more Condense
displayDescription: Gain a 1.5x Multiplier to all earned Condense at the end of each Dungeon!
